metals.name: Gold
metals.note: The monetary metal. No cash flow, so price is entirely about real rates and demand.

metals.name: Silver
metals.note: Half monetary metal, half industrial. Roughly twice gold's volatility.

metals.name: Platinum
metals.note: Mostly an industrial metal (autocatalysts). Supply is concentrated in South Africa.

metals.name: Palladium
metals.note: Autocatalyst demand; has been the most volatile of the four.

metals.name: Nippon Gold ETF
metals.note: Tracks domestic gold price; 1 unit is roughly 1/100 oz. No making charge.

metals.name: Nippon Silver ETF
metals.note: Domestic silver price; tighter spread than physical silver.

ratio.caveat: Slow, long-horizon context. It has stayed above 60 for years at a time, so it is not a timing signal on its own.
ratio.label: ratio is within its usual range
ratio.scale: ounces of silver per ounce of gold
